items.current_title: Economy: trend sparkline empty-state + longer history seed
items.new_title: Fix economy sparkline empty-state and history seed [system:economy]
items.body_summary: Economy trend panel renders flat lines because only one month of history is seeded and the chart shows `min 2.12 · max 2.12`. Either seed ~12 months of historical data in each scenario's `economy.json`, or render a 'collecting data…' empty state when the series has fewer than 3 distinct points.
acceptance: 12 months of seeded history in each scenario's `economy.json`, OR
Empty-state render when series has < 3 distinct points
Sparkline min/max no longer collapse on seeded scenarios
